sections.title: The letter é
paragraphs: The letter name is (é) /eː/. Its main sound is a vowel. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear it in (ég) /eːɡ/, which means sky. This letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: Pronunciation of é
paragraphs: Spread your lips wide into a smile. Keep your jaw fairly close to your upper teeth. Push the front of your tongue high and forward in your mouth. Let your vocal cords vibrate freely. Hold the sound steady without moving your tongue or jaw. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules for é
paragraphs: The accent mark tells you that this letter is always a long vowel. An accent mark is a diacritic written above a letter. A long sound is a sound that you hold for more time. You say this sound in every position. Listen to it in the word (kép) /keːp/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with é
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into a diphthong. A diphthong is two vowel sounds in one syllable, where the sound glides. Avoid the English vowel sound in the word say. Keep your jaw and tongue completely still until the sound ends.
